explanation: The halter-neck dress was designed by William Travilla. The scene was first filmed on a New York street, but crowds and noise forced a reshoot on a studio set.

claims.text: In The Seven Year Itch (1955), Marilyn Monroe's character stands over a subway grate as her white dress billows up.
Grace Kelly, Doris Day and Kim Novak do not appear in The Seven Year Itch.
The white halter-neck dress was designed by the costume designer William Travilla.
The scene was first shot on a New York street, and the version in the film was reshot on a studio set after crowd noise spoiled the location footage.
